claims.claim_ar: افتتاح بالقول بأمر القائل «قُلْ» لاستدعاء الكلام وإظهار موقف المتكلم وقطع الشكّ؛ أسلوب إنشائي يقدم بيان النفي كتصريح حكمي.
claims.claim_en: The imperative introductory 'قُلْ' is used to introduce the speaker's statement — an act of enunciation/creation (inshā’) that asserts the speaker's stance decisively and frames what follows as an authoritative reply.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Frames the following prohibition as the Prophet’s clear, authoritative reply and distances the ruling from popular opinion.

claims.claim_ar: حرف استثناء وحصر (إِلَّا) يقيد العموم بالنَّصّ على الحالات المفصّلة؛ فيبيّن أن التحريم لا يشمل إلا الحالات المذكورة.
claims.claim_en: The particle 'إِلَّا' functions as restriction/exception, limiting the general prohibition to the specific cases enumerated.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Narrows and clarifies the legal ruling, preventing overgeneralization and focusing attention on the listed exceptions.

warnings: Source chunks provided are mainly exegetical/grammatical extracts (al-Kashshaf / al-Jadwal). Claims were limited to rhetorical observations that can be supported by exact substrings found in those chunks.
